verdict.rationale: Porkbun's own docs show an unusually broad API covering registration, renewal and transfer, full DNS CRUD, SSL bundles, static and WordPress hosting, Cloudflare zone moves, marketplace and closeout purchases, auto-renew and webhooks, several described as "no dashboard". However, nothing states UI/API parity, and some functions appear UI-only, such as key scoping "from the gear icon"; email hosting also has no API evidence. missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or endpoint coverage map, API evidence for email hosting and API-key/account management, independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: A clean REST/JSON API to register, renew, transfer and fully manage domains
create hosting (15-day free trial, one per domain), upload site files, and serve a static site over HTTPS, entirely via the API
npx @porkbunllc/mcp-server — 96 tools for Claude, Cursor and any MCP client.
